facts: Original post retained verbatim in jd.txt; private Upwork metadata is in intake-private.json.
The post asks for management and improvement of CRM and marketing workflows, lead capture, automations, email sequences, campaign tracking, troubleshooting, and part-time independent support.
GoHighLevel is named in the title. No business name, client contact name, industry, current campaign, existing workflow defect, or baseline performance is supplied.
Jordan Reed, Sam Lee, website-enquiry, Website enquiry October, timestamps, messages, and the opportunity are invented sample data, not client facts.
The form-to-tag setup is upstream of the displayed workflow. Contact Tag is configured for Tag Added = website-enquiry; this trigger does not itself apply the tag.

GHL supported adapter keys used: contact_tag, assign_user, opportunity, email, wait. Stop on Response is a workflow setting, not a node. The opportunity stage after reply is changed by the sample owner, not an unsupported automation.
Official GHL Contact Tag documentation checked 2026-10-19: https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002482-workflow-trigger-contact-tag

Official GHL workflow settings documentation checked 2026-10-19: https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001239875 ; Stop on Response ends this contact's workflow when they reply to a message sent from this workflow.
No client-specific or past-delivery claim is made. Result proof is a visible illustrative contact trace, not live execution evidence.

metrics.name: Unassigned form leads
metrics.definition: Distinct form leads without an assigned owner at the agreed daily checkpoint, divided by all form leads received in that period. Report by form and campaign.

metrics.name: First-response time
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from form submission to the first enquiry email sent to that contact. Report by campaign and separate failed sends from successful sends.

metrics.name: Lead-to-conversation rate
metrics.definition: Distinct leads with an incoming email reply divided by distinct captured leads in the same campaign cohort, using an agreed observation period. Count each lead once.
